title: Geode Inn — MarketItem Enrichment Manifest
description: Complete product data sync from Elio staging to live Geode Inn app. Each entry maps to a live MarketItem record by ID and provides stoneType, loreConnection, priceRange, realImage, and realName.

updates.name: Garnet, gold and spinel earrings
updates.loreConnection: Garnet (Stone entity), Spinel (Stone entity). Connected to the Undercity and Klimt's Death and Life aesthetic.

updates.name: Silver, black onyx, and pietersite earrings
updates.loreConnection: Black Onyx (Stone entity, facetable despite opacity), Pietersite (Stone entity). Connected to the acoustic architecture and dialogue systems.
updates.realName: Silver, black onyx, and pietersite earrings

updates.name: Baltic amber, amethyst and silver earrings (variant)
updates.loreConnection: Baltic Amber (Stone entity), Amethyst (Stone entity). Connected to the Hearth and fire mechanics.
updates.realName: Baltic amber, amethyst and silver earrings

updates.name: Baltic amber, amethyst and silver earrings
updates.loreConnection: Baltic Amber (Stone entity), Amethyst (Stone entity). Connected to the Hearth and fire mechanics.
updates.realName: Baltic amber, amethyst and silver earrings

updates.name: Sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz drops
updates.loreConnection: Sunstone (Stone entity), Garnet (Stone entity), London Blue Topaz (Stone entity). Connected to the Water Zone and tidal mechanics.
updates.realName: Sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz drops

updates.name: Peridot, amber and amethyst earrings
updates.loreConnection: Peridot (Stone entity), Amber (Stone entity), Amethyst (Stone entity). Connected to the Canopy Zone and Fae Kingdom acoustics.

updates.name: Viking earrings
updates.loreConnection: Connected to the Norse zone (Book of Kells artist assignment) and Viking mythology in the Lore entity.

updates.name: Aquamarine, Carnelian and Onyx
updates.loreConnection: Aquamarine (Stone entity), Carnelian (Stone entity), Onyx (Stone entity). Connected to the Water Zone and the Selkie questline.

updates.name: Bloodlust
updates.loreConnection: Connected to the Shadow Inn (84Hz) and the combat/truth duality. The name reflects the Inn's honesty about its darker zones.

updates.name: LIMITED EDITION 5 Strand Gemstone Necklace
updates.loreConnection: Connected to all five levels of the Inn. The 5-strand design mirrors the Inn's vertical descent structure. This is the legendary piece of the collection.

updates.name: Triple moon with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon
updates.loreConnection: Smoky Quartz (Stone entity), Agate (Stone entity), Garnet (Stone entity). The triple moon connects to the Inn's three creators. Silk ribbon = the thread of the narrative.
updates.realName: Triple moon with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon

updates.name: The Bluestone Key
updates.loreConnection: Preseli Blue Stone from the Stone entity. Connected to the Standing Stones game (Phase 1 Tetris) and the Fae Kingdom portal system. The bluestone is the physical key to the game's biggest zone.

updates.name: The Truth-Teller's Ring
updates.loreConnection: Malachite stone from the Stone entity. Connected to the Crone's character and her precision-without-cushioning philosophy. Also references Krista's Artisan Thief class — the jeweler who knows malachite is toxic when ground.

updates.name: The Aurora Pendant
updates.loreConnection: Labradorite stone from the Stone entity. Connected to the Catalyst's garden and the Fae Kingdom portal system. The stone's color-shift mirrors the Fae realm's shifting geography.

updates.name: The Cat's Eye of Bastet
updates.loreConnection: Cat's Eye Chrysoberyl from the Stone entity. Connected to Bastet's Herding game and the Egyptian zone's cat mechanics. Krista's love of cats is embedded in the lore.

updates.name: Leather and skulls
updates.loreConnection: Connected to the Catacombs zone and the Inn's death/remembrance themes.

updates.name: Tiny sunstone necklace
updates.loreConnection: Sunstone (Stone entity). Connected to the Cosmology level and the Inn's warmth frequencies. The smallest piece in the collection — proof that the Inn's power is not in size but in presence.

updates.name: Shield pendant
updates.loreConnection: Connected to Lozen's Sentinel questline and the Inn's guardian mechanics. The shield is the Inn's promise that not everything needs to be faced alone.

updates.name: Thistle necklace
updates.loreConnection: Connected to the Scottish/Celtic zones and the Book of Kells artist assignment. The thistle is Scotland's emblem — beauty that defends itself.

updates.name: Star pendant
updates.loreConnection: Connected to the Clockwork Skies zone and the Navigator's star charts. Every star in the Inn is a direction someone hasn't tried yet.

updates.name: Trinity pendant
updates.loreConnection: Connected to the Inn's three creators — Krista, River, and Charles. The trinity is not a symbol of faith in the Inn but a symbol of family.
